happy_start.line: That's wonderful to hear! Your happiness is contagious! 🌟 What's been making you smile lately?

happy_good_thing.line: Ooh, I love good surprises! 🎉 Life has a way of sprinkling little gifts when we least expect them. Want to tell me more, or should we celebrate in another way?

options.text: Let's celebrate! Tell me a joke!
I want to savor this feeling

happy_overall.line: Sometimes the best days are the ones where everything just... works! Like all the puzzle pieces fit perfectly. 🧩 How do you want to keep this good energy going?

happy_achievement.line: Look at you go! 🌟 Every step forward is worth celebrating, big or small. You put in the effort, and it showed! How does it feel?

happy_celebrate_joke.line: Why did the panda like the bamboo restaurant? Because it had great stalks! 🎋😄 Okay okay, I know, my jokes are panda-monium! Want to keep the good vibes rolling?

options.text: Yes! What else can we do?
I'm good for now, thank you!

happy_savor.line: That's beautiful. Sometimes we just need to pause and let the good feelings wash over us like warm sunshine. ☀️ You deserve these moments, friend.

happy_fun_activity.line: Now you're speaking my language! 🐼 How about trying the claw machine? We just got some adorable new prizes! Or we could do something else—your choice!

options.text: Maybe later, just want to chill

happy_feels_amazing.line: Yes! Soak in that feeling! This is what growth looks like, and you're absolutely crushing it! 💪✨

happy_proud.line: And you should be! That mixture of pride and relief means you challenged yourself and came out on top. That takes courage! 🌈

happy_whats_next.line: Well, we could explore the shop for some fun customizations, play a game, or just hang out! The world is our bamboo forest! 🎋

happy_loop.line: You've brought such good energy today! I'm so glad we got to share this happy moment together. 💚 How's your heart feeling now?
